title: NOC panel brightened colors (08-23 high-contrast ruling) have zero test coverage
evidence:
NOC_TXT_DIM   :: rl.Color{195, 206, 220, 255} // body numbers (08-23: high-contrast ruling)
NOC_LABEL     :: rl.Color{174, 186, 200, 255} // small-caps labels (08-23: high-contrast ruling)
NOC_LABEL_DIM :: rl.Color{128, 140, 156, 255} // section rules (08-23: high-contrast ruling)
— grep for NOC_TXT_DIM/NOC_LABEL outside noc_overlay.odin: no matches; contrast_ratio is referenced only by app/render/font_test.odin, which pins ink_soft_text vs canvas only.
detail: P2 gap: the NOC overlay is PP_DEBUG-gated (invisible to T2 goldens) and no unit/pixel test pins these values. A regression dimming them back passes every gate and golden.
recommended_fix: Add a pin asserting NOC_TXT_DIM/NOC_LABEL clear a contrast floor vs the dark plate (reuse contrast_ratio), or extend overlay_pixels_check to sample label pixels.

title: No automated test renders a non-ASCII glyph through the merged-atlas draw path
detail: P2 gap on the ⚠ acceptance: pins are data-stage only (glyph present/absent). DrawTextEx's value-keyed lookup over appended fallback glyphs is exercised only by the manual font-check specimen; goldens never draw non-ASCII.
recommended_fix: Add an rlsw pixel probe (overlay-pixels pattern): draw "\xe2\x9a\xa0" via draw_text_font, assert non-blank pixels inside the glyph rect.

title: Header SemiBold weight distinction is unpinned — FONT_HEADER_ASSET is loaded by no test
evidence:
FONT_HEADER_ASSET    :: "assets/fonts/ibm_plex_sans_semibold.ttf"
— repo-wide grep: FONT_HEADER_ASSET appears only in view.odin (loader); font_header only at app/main.odin:1835 (rnd.draw_text_font(app.view.font_header, ...)). font_test.odin loads FONT_ASSET, FONT_MONO_ASSET, FONT_FALLBACK_ASSET only.
detail: P3 gap: goldens pin the rendered header pixels, but a wrong-weight semibold asset re-blessed deliberately would pass silently — the PR's headline fix ('esp the headers') has no mechanical sensitivity pin.
recommended_fix: Extend font_mono_tabular_digits-style pin: assert font_glyph_advance(header, 'A') differs from body's (weight distinction), matching the existing sensitivity pattern.

title: font_merge_fallback secondary error branches (garbage fallback, completeness scan) untested
detail: P3 gap: the readable-but-garbage fallback path and the W2 completeness-scan failure (view.odin:1434-1448) have no direct pin; the failure class is covered, the branches are not.
recommended_fix: One more case in font_guard_reports_missing_asset: font_merge_fallback(FONT_ASSET, "data/palette.json", ...) must return nil (readable garbage fallback fails loud).

title: PP_SW_AUDIO app build is compiled by gate 12 but never executed; gallery runtime is manual-only
evidence:
ODIN_ROOT="$SHADOW" odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -define:PP_SW_AUDIO=true -out:bin/app-gallery-sw-check
./bin/harness-debug-sw overlay-pixels qos_contention 12000ms
— no gate or test runs bin/app-gallery-sw-check; app/gallery.odin's stage machine (incl. the GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES abort) has no automated execution.
detail: P3 gap: the seam stubs are compile-checked only (signature drift caught; runtime not). The wrapper design itself was ruled behavior-preserving — only the missing runtime smoke is noted.
recommended_fix: Extend gate 12: run bin/app-gallery-sw-check with PP_FONT_GALLERY=<committed ttf>; assert exit 0 and the six artifacts exist.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: fail-loud loader pinned headless (font_guard_reports_missing_asset: missing + garbage assets) and end-to-end via gate 13 (harness exit 2). P1 ≈95%: ⚠ positive+negative data pins, tabular+sensitivity pin, ink_soft_text 7:1 + fold + pre-fold-byte pins, T1/replay byte-identity, 48/48 re-blessed goldens. Overall ≈83%: goldens pin family/size/header pixels on every text-bearing demo; uncovered tail is NOC debug-surface values, non-ASCII render integration, and debug-tool runtime.
recommended_fix: Add the ⚠ pixel-render probe and a NOC contrast pin (raises overall to ~90%); optionally execute the SW-audio/gallery smoke in gate 12.
